newsitem.title: USA: Heritage US Government Income cuts dividend.
newsitem.headline: Heritage US Government Income cuts dividend.

text.p: Heritage U.S. Government Income Fund said Friday that it will reduce its monthly dividend from $0.08 per share to $0.077 per share effective with the August 15 record date.
In a statement, president Stephen Hill said "The new dividend rate reflects current market conditions of lower interest rates and a significantly flatter yield curve.
"With a narrower margin between short-term borrowing rates and longer-term lending rates, the amount of excess income the fund can produce utilizing leveraged strategies is sharply curtailed."
